workspace.title: My workspace
workspace.blockedOwner: The platform owner has no staff record in an institution, so there is nothing personal to show.
workspace.blockedHrOff: Staff & HR is not switched on for this institution, so there is no staff record to show.
workspace.loadFailed: Your record could not be loaded: {{error}}
workspace.askHr: Ask HR to link your login to your staff record — until then only Account & security has anything to show.
workspace.tryLater: Try again in a moment; Account & security still works.

account.kioskPinSet: Set — punch on any attendance kiosk with your employee code and this PIN.
account.kioskPinNotSet: Not set yet. You need it to punch on an attendance kiosk.
account.kioskPinWarn: Don’t share it — a punch made with it is yours. Several wrong PINs in a row lock your code on the kiosks for a few minutes.
account.changePasswordSub: Other devices are signed out when you change it.
account.newPasswordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
account.signInSecuritySub: Your confirmed email lets you reset a forgotten password and get sign-in codes.
account.emailVerifiedHint: You can reset a forgotten password from the sign-in page.
account.emailUnverifiedHint: Confirm it to reset a forgotten password yourself and to use sign-in codes.
account.emailCode: Or enter the code from the email
account.emailCodeSent: Sent to {{sentTo}}. Click “Confirm my email” in it — or type its code here (10 minutes).
account.twoStep: Ask for a code at every sign-in
account.twoStepHint: After your password, we email you a 6-digit code. Someone who knows your password still can’t get in.
account.twoStepRequired: Your role requires a code at every sign-in.
account.noPlatformEmail: The platform can’t send email yet, so these options are off for now.
account.myAccessSub: Roles are managed by your institution’s administrator.
